# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are provided for the latest stable release and the current
`main` branch.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately through GitHub Security
Advisories:

https://github.com/alexkramse/filament-openapi-docs/security/advisories/new

Do not open a public issue or discussion for suspected vulnerabilities. Include
enough detail to reproduce the issue, such as affected versions, configuration,
steps to trigger the vulnerability, and any relevant proof of concept.

The maintainer will review the report, coordinate a fix when needed, and publish
details after affected users have had a reasonable opportunity to update.
